short: The Allied landings in Normandy on 6 June 1944, the largest seaborne invasion ever mounted.
full:
Operation Overlord put roughly 156,000 Allied troops ashore across five Normandy beaches on 6 June 1944, supported by nearly 7,000 vessels and 24,000 airborne troops landed overnight.

Its success depended as much on deception as on force: Operation Bodyguard convinced the German command that the main assault would fall at Pas-de-Calais, holding substantial reserves in the wrong place for weeks. Casualties were heaviest at Omaha Beach. Within eleven months the Allies had crossed the Rhine and Germany had surrendered, and the invasion opened the Western Front that the Soviet Union had demanded for three years.
